Our purpose

Make everyday freight work clearer.

Relocation Manager USA is being built for the practical gap between a business that needs something moved and the truck that can move it safely and profitably.

Why this exists

The load details should answer the driver’s real questions.

A city pair and a price are not enough. Drivers need to know equipment fit, dimensions, weight, loading conditions, site readiness, timing, payment terms, and who they are working with. Shippers need a clear way to describe the pickup and compare qualified responses.

Who we are focused on

Our first focus is the work that often falls between consumer moving tools and large national freight networks: 15–26-foot box trucks, cargo vans, hotshots, and relocation-related freight, with direct pickup requests from businesses and customers.

How we intend to earn trust

  • Remove or expire stale opportunities aggressively.
  • Show exact equipment and site-readiness requirements.
  • Build reputation from completed work and response history.
  • Keep public safety and educational material open.
  • Publish marketplace performance only when the underlying activity is real and verified.

What we are not

Relocation Manager USA is a marketplace and coordination platform. We are not the carrier, broker, insurer, shipper, or payment guarantor in a transaction. Every participant remains responsible for independently verifying identity, authority, insurance, freight, equipment, payment, and contract terms.
